_note: Well-known clothing model lines, including older and discontinued ones, so a traveller can add what they own by name. Values are coarse on purpose (warmth level, waterproof yes/no): a model line keeps them across versions. 'older' marks a model that was replaced or renamed. Entries with an empty brand are everyday pieces for when the name is forgotten. Add a model only when you know what it is.
